research.note: Bootstrap 5 HTML snippets and UI components for landing pages, with a free open-source core and paid full set.
unverified: The free core components are in the public repository ayroui/bootstrap-ui-components (MIT, last commit 2022-06-15); that repository has not been researched yet, and the paid full set is not public.
The update log at https://ayroui.com/update-logs lists version 2.0 without a date, so lastUpdated uses the last commit to the free core repository.
